title: Excellent investment for pumping on the go - not a main machine
review_text:
I ended up exclusively pumping for my little one for 13+ months - that means I spent A LOT of time connected to my breast pump. I had both an S1 and S2 for the first few months and loved them. When I went back to work, even those were a lot to lug around, so I invested in the S9 so I could pump on the go.

Pros:
- Extremely Lightweight
- Very Portable
- Uses all the same Spectra parts as the full-time machines
- Fits in a very small bag (and some cupholders)
- Works on battery alone or plugged (to the wall or the car charger)

Cons
- Suction decreases on battery power alone (I would often leave this plugged in to get more juice) - no pun intended.
- Less configuration options with speed and suction - I always just sort of had it on max.
- Not a great solo machine. I think it would be hard for this to be your only pump. I only used it when i was pumping in the car or at work - at any other time I much preferred the suction and options of my S1 or S2.
- It's not the loudest machine, but it certainly isn't quiet. You aren't going to be able to pump in a movie theater or anything.

Bottom line - if you need to pump on the go - this is a great investment.

title: Review after a year and a half of use and this pillow falls flat
review_text:
My toddler started using this pillow in Feb 2021. I trusted this company to provide a safe pillow and they have. It isn’t stinky or caused any allergies just as promised. He sleeps face first into it and I can breath easy know he’ll breath easy.

I wouldn’t sleep on it happily so I won’t let me kiddo either. I washed it as directed - every other week, my kid is a total sweat head when he sleeps - and it’s super fluffy the first night and then after that it’s totally flat and balled up into clumps. This started around the one year mark but really got icky about a month or two ago. So I’ll be switching brands for the next one solely for durability. If you want short term and safe this is a great pillow but if you want it to last look elsewhere.

title: 3 kids in the last 18 years... Very easy install!!!
review_text:
Love this car seat!!! I have gone through 3 kids now over a long period of time and seem the awesome designs transform in car seats! I have an 18 year old that just started college, a 6 year old that just started 1st grade (now in a booster), and our new 2020 baby from Feb (now 8months). The baby is 90th percentile (looks like a 1 year old) so it was time for a new car seat as she is almost at height and weight for the carrier now.

That being said... I love how easy this was to install!!!! I think the leg extensions will be very nice for her when it’s forward facing, but for now it’s rear facing. It was easy to adjust the tilt, although when I was installing I tried to adjust the tilt and was pulling the leg rest up on accident.

The best thing!!! Is the strap adjustments!!! Gone are the days of having to unhook it from the back and re-feed it through the higher level as they grow!!! That is sooo cool! Last photo is the pull to adjust the harness! Love ❤️
sentence: Love this car seat!!

title: These things were great in theory but in practice
review_text: These things were great in theory but in practice, they just don't measure up to the real deals ones. The bags themselves are fine, they hold in the odor really well and they are strong enough not to rip no matter what you do with them. The issue with these is, as said in a few other reviews, that they come out way too fast in the Diaper Genie. For reference, I have the essentials which I'm a fan of. The issue is that when you push the diaper into the pail, it pulls much more bag than it needs so that you blow through it much faster than you would otherwise need. When I change out the pail, I usually end up with about 2/3 of the Nursery Fresh Refill unfilled, its like 1.5 feet of diaper when I shake it down but over 3 feet of nothing but air. For the mild savings over the name brand ones, you waste much more product so it becomes a worse deal. As other reviewers have pointed out as well, I did try leaving the ring on it so that it comes out slower and that seemed to help only a tiny bit as well as making it very difficult to put the top piece back on tightly. The product works but its not a better deal than the name brand products, am not buying again.
sentence: These things were great in theory but in practice, they just don't measure up to the real deals ones.
